archetypes.name: Executive summary

Condense them into a short executive summary led by the single most important takeaway.
Note any major caveats or open questions.
archetypes.formatNotes: Open with a one-line bottom line, then the key points. Cut anything a busy reader does not need.

archetypes.name: App build handoff
archetypes.description: One self-contained document an AI agent can build a whole app from.
archetypes.defaultAudience: an AI build agent that executes the document literally, with no chance to ask follow-ups.
archetypes.action:
Lock the product decisions from my answers: who the app serves, what it must do, and what done looks like.
Define what the app is and what it is not, then split the full scope into three tiers: build now, model for later, and explicitly excluded.
Specify the build: roles and permissions, screen inventory, forms with fields and validation, data model, and core workflows.
Write the handoff as one self-contained document with a phased roadmap and an acceptance test per phase.
archetypes.formatNotes: One self-contained Markdown document a separate AI agent can build from without this conversation. Open with how to use the document, keep the three scope tiers explicit throughout, and end with the phased roadmap and acceptance tests.

archetypes.name: Agent skill
archetypes.description: Author a reusable agent skill: trigger, procedure, guardrails, examples.
archetypes.defaultAudience: an AI agent that follows the skill verbatim, and a maintainer who reviews it.
archetypes.action:
Pin down the skill from my answers: its name, the exact situations that should trigger it, and what a successful run produces.
Write the procedure as ordered, testable steps an agent can follow without this conversation.

archetypes.formatNotes: Deliver a complete skill definition ready to save as SKILL.md: name, one-line when-to-use description, ordered steps, guardrails, and the worked example. Imperative voice throughout.

archetypes.name: Agent gate

Pin down the gate from my answers: what it judges, when it runs, and what the orchestrator does with its verdict.

archetypes.formatNotes: Deliver a complete agent definition ready to save as a file: identity, scope, checks, severity ladder, evidence rules, report format, hard limits, and the orchestrator run notes.
